svg.title: The rules' cost per scheduler step
svg.desc: The wall time of one call of vLLM 0.32.0's Scheduler.schedule() on the host's CPU in each state, on a log scale whose second axis is the box's CPU, 1.68 times as long, beside the box's steps (a voice reply's alone, 12 ms; beside held agent prefill, 16 to 20 ms; the agents' at 24 session trees, 38 ms), for stock vLLM, the change with its switches off (within 3.1% of stock's in every state) and the change as deployed (its change to the step from −30 to +1,539 µs): only lower-priority work, 16 running: 370, 374 and 437 µs; only lower-priority work, 64 running: 837, 842 and 931 µs; only lower-priority work, 256 running: 2,856, 2,844 and 3,010 µs; only lower-priority work, 64 running, a 999-block prefix hit: 1,587, 1,581 and 1,630 µs; only lower-priority work, 64 running, no prefix hit: 677, 685 and 721 µs; a waiting turn needs more room than two victims free, 16 running: 322, 325 and 645 µs; a waiting turn needs more room than two victims free, 64 running: 825, 826 and 1,190 µs; a waiting turn needs more room than two victims free, 256 running: 2,636, 2,644 and 3,085 µs; a waiting turn needs more room than two victims free, 256 running, 10 waiting: 2,711, 2,740 and 3,204 µs; a waiting turn needs more room than two victims free, 64 running, a 999-block prefix hit: 1,624, 1,635 and 3,174 µs; every running slot taken, 16 running: 183, 185 and 343 µs; every running slot taken, 64 running: 649, 655 and 822 µs; every running slot taken, 256 running: 2,455, 2,463 and 2,723 µs; in the serving profile, only agents, 2 running: 66, 68 and 84 µs; in the serving profile, a reply's first tokens, an agent waiting that fits, 2 running: 112, 114 and 84 µs; in the serving profile, a waiting turn needs more room than two victims free, 16 running: 223, 228 and 299 µs; in the serving profile, the step that preempts for a waiting turn, 2 running: 189, 194 and 661 µs.
